title: Pressure ulcers: site, stage and healing
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's pressure ulcer, if any.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up of pressure ulcer.

HPI
Pt is an 87y/o female presenting for follow-up of a pressure injury on the right heel. She reports some discomfort but denies fever or chills. Wound appears to be progressing slowly. She has been diligent with offloading and dressing changes at home.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Atorvastatin 20mg QD
Aspirin 81mg QD

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, oriented x3.
Skin: Pressure ulcer on the right heel noted. Wound is a stage 3 pressure injury. Granulation tissue present. No purulent drainage or foul odor. Periwound skin intact.
Vitals: BP 132/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 97% on RA.

Assessment
1. Pressure ulcer of the right heel.

Plan
- Continue current wound care regimen.
- Cleanse with normal saline, apply antimicrobial dressing.
- Maintain strict offloading of the right heel.
- F/u in 2 weeks for wound re-evaluation.

Electronically signed, R. Mensah, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Pressure ulcer of the right heel, stage 3: L89.613 (HCC 381).

distractors.why: The stage is documented: it decides the code and the HCC.
